semiconductor_relevance: High — ABM, Inc. specializes in lithography systems and process equipment essential for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: ABM, Inc. is a global leader in lithography equipment manufacturing, providing advanced lithography systems and process support for the production of integrated circuits, MEMS, and optical devices. The company offers a comprehensive range of services including equipment R&D, process optimization, and after-sales support.
capabilities: Micro-nano optical devices such as FAC Lens and Micro-lens Array

regional_presence.China: ABM is set to participate in SEMICON China 2026, indicating a strategic focus on the Chinese market.
